key_insight: AMM routes a fixed evaluation budget among classical optimizers using online landscape probes, achieving the highest target share in 382 of 600 held-out BBOB test cells.
engineering_relevance: For continuous black-box engineering optimization, AMM offers budget-aware solver selection through an open-source Python package: amm-optimizer.
method: Probe curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure online.
Route evaluations among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy engines.
Charge probe costs to the budget and specify defaults and dimension–budget validity ranges.
evidence_signal: On held-out BBOB instances 101–110, spanning dimensions 2–40 and budgets of 10D–1000D, AMM led outright in 236 cells and tied in 146; a descriptive posterior rule placed it credibly behind in 35.
watch_item: Gains are landscape- and budget-dependent: rotating separable functions removed most of the lead there, and held-out MA-BBOB showed final parity with IPOP-CMA-ES but lower anytime area.
paper_title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
